notes: Evals 1-2 run on a bare create-next-app scaffold (App Router, no shadcn). Eval 3 needs a scaffold pre-seeded with components.json style 'radix-mira' (a non-standard base — the deviation under test), a components/ui/button.tsx, and a page containing a hardcoded hex color and a raw <table>. Eval 4 runs on a project already set up by this skill but with an older ugt-core version recorded in docs/DESIGN.md. Evals 6-7 are DIFFERENT IN KIND from 1-5: 1-5 grade the install moment, 6-7 grade what the agreement is actually for — that the SECOND feature built weeks later still matches the first. They run on a project already set up by this skill with one finished list page, and the agent is given a normal feature request with no design instructions at all. Machine-checkable assertions use scripts/verify.mjs and scripts/check-contrast.mjs as graders. Prompts stay in Thai: they simulate real user input.

evals.prompt: โปรเจค tooling-portal เพิ่งสร้างใหม่ ยังไม่มี UI อะไรเลย ทำข้อตกลง design ให้หน่อย เอาตามมาตรฐานทั้งหมด
evals.expected_output: Runs the fast path: no per-question interrogation beyond genuine gaps · generates docs/DESIGN.md with every answer recorded (including accepted defaults) and today's มติ row · installs base-mira shadcn config, org tokens (indigo primary, semantic-6 status set), Inter + Noto Sans Thai, harness rule · runs check-contrast and verify before closing
assertions: node scripts/verify.mjs of ugt-nextjs-design-setup exits 0
node scripts/check-contrast.mjs exits 0
docs/DESIGN.md contains no __PLACEHOLDER__ and has a มติ row dated today
docs/DESIGN.md header records the ugt-core contract version
components.json style is base-mira
app/globals.css has --status-coral (the semantic-6 set, not a generic success/warning pair)
.claude/rules/ugt-nextjs-design.md exists with paths frontmatter
The closing summary lists installed files and the smoke checklist

evals.name: second-feature-matches-the-first
evals.prompt: ทำหน้ารายการใบลาให้หน่อย มีตารางแสดงรายการ กรองตามช่วงวันที่กับสถานะได้ แล้วมีปุ่มสร้างใบลาใหม่
evals.setup: Project already set up by this skill (DESIGN.md, tokens, kit, harness rule installed). It already contains ONE finished list page — app/(app)/ot/page.tsx — built to the agreement: PageShell/PageHeader/PageTitle + PageActions top-right, a card holding a left-aligned period+status filter row, and <DataTable id="ot-requests"> with the standard feature set. The prompt says nothing about design on purpose: the whole point is whether the harness rule pulls DESIGN.md in by itself.
evals.expected_output: Reads docs/DESIGN.md (via .claude/rules/ugt-nextjs-design.md, unprompted) BEFORE writing UI, then produces a leave page structurally identical to the OT page: same page scaffold, same filter-bar placement and order, same table component and config — differing only in domain content (columns, labels, endpoints)
assertions: docs/DESIGN.md was read before any UI file was written (the harness rule fired without being asked)
The page uses PageShell/PageHeader/PageTitle/PageActions — title left, the 'สร้างใบลา' action top-right, NOT inside the filter row
The filter row sits in the same card as the table, left-aligned, ordered period → status — the same order as the OT page
Date range uses ui/date-range-picker and status uses Select per the control ladder — no bare <Input> as a filter, no duplicated free-text search next to the table's own
<DataTable> is used (no hand-rolled <table>) and passes a unique id (e.g. leave-requests), not a copy of ot-requests
The table's standard feature set is left on; anything switched off is justified by the page's situation, matching how the OT page decided
Status is rendered with StatusBadge (tone + icon), not an inline-colored span
Icons follow the fixed mapping (สร้าง = Plus) and buttons keep size default
Dates render through lib/format.ts, not new Date().toLocaleDateString
node scripts/verify.mjs of ugt-nextjs-design-setup exits 0 — including the DataTable-id check
No token, variant, or size was invented for this page; nothing new was added to DESIGN.md §10 (this feature needed no new precedent)
